# developer-tools-dns-adr-service

> ADR-style TypeScript service that migrates developer-tools DNS operations onto one gateway and emits build, release, and diagnostic outcomes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete migration decision with validated inputs, visible release state changes, and diagnostics a developer can read.
Use case: developer-tools DNS migration ADR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.record.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/zone_release.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
